g.text: FPGA100T / actual power and ground routing progress
40 × 36 mm · 126 components · one custom cable connector · no test points
25 control/flash/clock nets routed | 139 connections remain | global power distribution unfinished
Solid lines: outer-layer copper. Dashed lines: inner signal layers. Filled ground zones are omitted for clarity.
Removed: J2, J3, all 15 test points, separate power input, reset button and LED.
1010 trace segments + 146 vias + 4 ground zones. Native connectivity and schematic agreement checked.
Global power rails, 117 ASIC signals, the XEM8310 link and cable qualification remain unfinished.
